messages:
Alex Kim: Morning — I'm blocked on Okta activation. After I set my password it says "Approve device" but then shows "No devices enrolled". When I click enroll it opens Okta Verify and then errors with "Your org doesn't allow this device". On a personal MacBook. @Lina can you help?

Lina (People Ops): Hey Alex, welcome! :wave: What exact error does it show? Also is this a company laptop or personal? We usually send a temporary SSO lift for 48h if you don't have a company device yet.

Alex Kim: Personal MacBook Pro (macOS 13.6, Chrome). Screenshot attached. Error text: "Your org requires managed device for Okta Verify." Also I haven't received my 1Password invite so I can't get credentials.

IT Bot: Action required: device_enroll_needed for user alex.kim@redwood.com. See https://help.redwood.com/okta-enroll for steps.

Sam: We enforce device trust for some apps. People Ops usually toggles the temporary lift. @Lina maybe it didn't apply to Alex?

Lina (People Ops): Checking... looks like your temp lift wasn't applied on account creation. I'm reissuing it now, should take ~5 minutes. Meanwhile try signing in with "Sign in with Google" option if available.

Alex Kim: Tried Google SSO, it gets to account select then fails with "Account not provisioned".

Raj: Hey Alex — sometimes group provisioning lags. I'm going to kick a manual group sync for your email now. Can you confirm your exact corporate email and full name? Also which browser?

Alex Kim: alex.kim@redwood.com — Alex Kim. Chrome 120 on macOS.

Raj: Got it. Manual sync kicked at 1861200200. Also re-sending 1Password invite. Please retry in ~60s and report back.

Alex Kim: Success: I can log in now. Okta prompted for device enrollment again but I clicked "I don't have a company device" -> "Use a security key" and used a passkey via my phone. Enrollment accepted and 1Password invite arrived. Thanks all! :tada:

Maya (DevEx): Nice — if you need 1Password CLI for onboarding scripts, run: 

```
# sign in to 1Password via SSO
eval $(op signin --account redwood)
```

If the SSO redirect loops, try clearing cookies for okta and 1password domains or use an incognito window. Ping me if it still fails.

Alex Kim: One quick follow-up: I still sometimes see "device approval required" when accessing certain internal apps. Is that expected until I get my company laptop?

Lina (People Ops): Yes — the temporary lift is limited. Your company laptop was shipped yesterday (tracking #TRK123456). ETA 2 business days. Once you enroll the company device we revoke the lift. I'll email you next steps for corporate device enrollment and asset receipt.

IT Bot: Note: temporary_sso_override applied for alex.kim until 1861360000.

Alex Kim: Great, thanks everyone. This got me unblocked for the first-day tasks. Closing out.
